Import updated Excel

Original format: Branch and F.I.. Branch code is optional: upload without it and add codes later with Edit. Separate Branch Code, Old Branch Name and Old Branch Code columns are optional. Missing rows in an uploaded file are kept.

Codes keep leading zeros as shown in Excel. A name containing a code stays intact; codes are not guessed from names. Use an old name/code column when both the branch name and code change.

Review changes

Same bank + code matches are updates. Without a reliable match, choose Add as new or select the old branch. Unchecked and unresolved rows are skipped.
